input.user_message:
Read the Session 20 recap at `Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/Session 20 - Recap.md` and extract all meaningful scene events as structured event records.

For each distinct beat, fight, conversation, discovery, or confrontation in the recap, produce one event_record with:
- event_class (one of: conversation, travel, combat, discovery, transfer, ritual, betrayal, disaster, investigation, social_conflict)
- participants (use the known character slugs below — only include slugs that actually appear in that event)
- location (brief description of where it happens, or null if unspecified)
- outcomes (list of concrete results or facts established by the event)
- time_scope (use "scene" for specific session events)
- certainty (use "observed" for events directly described in the recap)
- event_name (short descriptive name for the event)
- evidence_id (set to the recap path: "Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/Session 20 - Recap.md")

Known character slugs: captain_lysandra_ironveil, dustwalker, sara_mirathorn_operator, thrin_branchborn, torbin_jove, caelynn, karsemine, ephanna, bonogo, marla_brambleback, stacey, stuart, stafl

Extract 10–20 events. Do not merge multiple distinct beats into a single event. Do not invent events not described in the recap.

expected_events.event_name: Red gnat swarm battle at forest edge
outcomes: Thrin lands second arrow, knocking a cluster out of the swarm
Ephanna's second Eldritch Blast hits and removes another cluster
Karsemine lands 4 scimitar and short-sword hits using Zephyr Strike then dashes away
Caelynn casts Thunderwave, splits swarm and pushes it back 10 feet
Swarm retreats into the forest

expected_events.event_name: Stuart confronts Stacey over stolen gold in warehouse
outcomes: Stuart demands gold back, convinced Stacey stole it
Stuart threatens Stacey with dart
Stacey throws gold pouch at Stuart and storms out

expected_events.event_name: Bonogo intimidates Stacey with knife threat in alley
outcomes: Bonogo grabs Stacey and holds knife to her throat
Warns her to stop bullying Stuart or he will return
Stacey runs home clearly shaken

expected_events.event_name: Party reports forest test findings to Stafl
outcomes: Party relays findings: do not attack trees directly
Forest responds to changes on the ground

expected_events.event_name: Marla Brambleback confronts Bonogo over Stacey harassment
outcomes: Marla attempts to slap Bonogo, misses
Marla berates Bonogo for encouraging Stuart to harass her daughter
Workers stop to watch the confrontation
Bonogo escalates, tells Marla he sees where Stacey gets her attitude
Marla grapples Bonogo

expected_events.event_name: Caelynn de-escalates Marla vs Bonogo confrontation with bracelet
outcomes: Caelynn uses bracelet to diffuse aggression
Everyone returns to work united against the approaching forest

expected_events.event_name: Fortification fires drive forest retreat eastward
outcomes: Ditch fires lit as forest reaches fortifications
Trees pull back and turn east, away from town
Town cheers, immediate danger resolved
Mayor and sheriff congratulate the heroes

expected_events.event_name: Mayor tells Caelynn no one in town has heard of Lysandra
outcomes: Mayor and sheriff have never heard of Captain Lysandra Ironveil

expected_events.event_name: Caelynn contacts Sara then connects directly to Lysandra via rockie-talkie
outcomes: Sara relays that Lysandra only heard mumbling about the forest leaving and something strange with time
Sara connects Caelynn directly to Lysandra
Lysandra is relieved the group is safe and forest is handled
Lysandra is exhausted and disoriented, remembers only going around the forest and smelling meat
Caelynn tells Lysandra to make camp and rest, Karsemine will track her

expected_events.event_name: Karsemine tracks Lysandra; group reaches wagon camp 30 minutes later
outcomes: Karsemine uses tracking skills to estimate distance and direction Lysandra traveled
Group finds partly unloaded wagon with horses wandering around crates after 30 minutes

expected_events.event_name: Lysandra found with shimmery cult eyes drawing a tower map in the dirt
outcomes: Lysandra found inside makeshift shelter drawing in dirt and mumbling
Her eyes are shimmery, matching the cult members seen earlier
Caelynn takes a closer look at the drawing; it appears as a top-down layout of a tower in the dirt
She says voices are coming from that tower and she knows where it is

expected_events.event_name: Caelynn administers antidote tea to cure Lysandra of cult influence
outcomes: Caelynn prepares antidote from tea in her bag while examining Lysandra's drawing in the dirt
Lysandra drinks the tea and comes out of the spell
Lysandra is very confused, does not know where she is or how she got there
She only remembers voices in the dark after the group left into the forest

expected_events.event_name: Stafl investigates provisions and finds tainted meat cleverly disguised in jerky crates
outcomes: Stafl sorts through provisions, suspects tainted meat was added before leaving Mirathorn
Bacon found untouched
Jerky crates contain cleverly disguised tainted meat mixed with the good jerky
Cannot separate good from tainted; entire crate must be burned

expected_events.event_name: Caelynn reports to Sara: Lysandra found safe and tainted meat discovered
outcomes: Sara told Lysandra is found safe
Sara told about tainted meat discovery
Sara is very concerned about who she can now trust in the city
Sara transfers Caelynn to Professor Tealeaf who does not pick up

expected_events.event_name: Ephanna announces Questionable Company departure; Marla asks Caelynn about Bonogo
outcomes: Marla approaches Caelynn asking how she should deal with Bonogo
Ephanna intervenes and announces Questionable Company is leaving town to continue journey

expected_events.event_name: Karsemine rounds up horses at wagon camp; observes magical storm approaching
outcomes: Karsemine rounds up wandering horses and ensures they are properly cared for
Observes storm still building in the distance but approaching camp
Storm appears to carry the magical shimmering rain

grading.se6_gold_rationale: expected_anchored_spans (including line_range) are set by reading the Session 20 recap in the canonical corpus and recording line numbers for recap-grounded evidence. This tightens the SE6 anchor-span contract against source text, not against any model extraction. Edits to these entries must be justified from corpus lines; they must not be chosen or revised to match what a model run emitted (that would be gold deflation, not realignment).

expected_anchored_spans.rationale: Ephanna lands Eldritch Blast during swarm battle
Thrin lands a telling bow shot and the swarm enfolds Caelynn before the line breaks
Stuart demands stolen gold and threatens Stacey with a dart in the warehouse
Stacey named as the bugbear leader; confrontation ends with the gold pouch thrown
Bonogo follows Stacey, holds a knife to her throat, then slips away
Stafl directing workers from a makeshift barrel throne; party reports forest test results to him
Marla’s Bugbear fury, Stafl gauging the crowd, and Marla grappling Bonogo before Caelynn’s bracelet
Lysandra at the wagon: shimmery cult eyes, tower drawing/layout in dirt (recap also says top-down blueprint), antidote tea breaks the compulsion
Sara learns Lysandra is safe and tainted meat is found; worry about who to trust; Tealeaf handoff
